card.title: Basically Finished

candidate.mechanism: D41 turns incomplete or improvised work into a supposedly thoughtful finished version.

candidate.distinguishingEvidence: A1 calls loose shelves finished; A3 labels missing installation a complete adjustable kit; A5 calls one installed shelf a finished approval sample.
candidate.alternativeComparison: This maker responds to a customer's insistence on installation by redefining partial construction as an approval stage; D41-single-b responds to a meeting deadline by redefining missing analysis as streamlined decision-making.
candidate.reason: Revised the cupboard handover, introducing loose shelves and a customer-supplied drill. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, A1/A3/A5 explicitly name thoughtful completion; logic 5, B2 causes the kit claim and B4 causes partial installation; relationship 4, B4 invokes paid work and supplies a tool; heightening 4, A5 makes the customer approve a newly reclassified partial deliverable; specificity 5, B2's missing supports identify the concrete fault; wit 4, A5's finished sample follows the demanded installation. Total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, 70 words; hard gates pass.
candidate.reservation: A5 offers only one shelf despite accepting installation; sincere belief in customer approval must carry the completion claim rather than a knowing refusal to work.
